title: Fix numeric coercion and deterministic group aggregation
prompt:
Fix the bugs in `csv_agg/aggregator.py`:
1. Empty strings, `'NA'`, `'N/A'`, or `'null'` (case-insensitive) in the value column must be skipped rather than crashing `float(...)`.
2. `aggregate_sum` must return groups sorted by total descending, with ties broken alphabetically by group key ascending.
3. Whitespace around group names and values should be stripped.
Run `pytest` and verify edge cases.
